column3: #2656 closed: LocalStorage.RestoreEnvironment now un-deletes the environment and re-reads the project FOR SHARE in one transaction, rolling back if it is gone; deleteProjectCascade row-locks the project BEFORE sweeping environments, so the sweep either sees the restored environment or the restore fails closed. The core ceiling check (requireAuthorityToReinstateProjectRoles) remains serial-equivalent. Proven: TestCTAReview_RestoreEnvironment_vs_DeleteProject_CrossReplicaPostgres, _DeleteProjectAfterUpdate_, _InsideDeleteProjectCascade_ (the last one fails without the cascade's up-front lock).
